comments.text: Sorry for being so late, but the workaround i used to make it launch, based on this appdb report/test results for 4.x https://appdb.winehq.org/objectManager.php?sClass=version&iId=42586 , which involved setting the exe of CSP itself to run in 8.1 mode (any other version would cause it to crash on boot), and anything relating to CLIP STUDIO (its launcher) would have to have edge installed along with webview in order to view the pages and make the launcher function, But that isnt related to CSP itself.

1. Download CSP from https://www.clipstudio.net/en/purchase/complete_win/
- The version downloaded is CSP_403w_setup.exe with sha1sum 5f065c2a5231862badea072af3d35b3a7ecfc294
2. Install in clean wine 10.12 prefix with default Windows 10 compatibility
3. Change Windows version to 8.1 specifically for ClipStudioPaint.exe in winecfg
4. Run CLIPStudio.exe, login with a license to get EX version, try save and export

I still couldn't reproduce, so additional information on anything different would be appreciated, especially full log, since that will allow me to try to fix this without being able to debug it on my end ;)
